about_the_game:
---ABOUT THIS GAME---

Residing in a small town, separated by big cities, wide neighborhoods, and tons of buildings.

In Cute Fame Highschool Days, you will utilize turn-based combat with familiar mechanics to the series, like time-based attacks, and using health for damage to find your way through dungeons. While also getting closer to saving an important character each in-game day through progression and side stories.

Cute Fame Highschool Days is developed by Cute Fame Studio, and is a prequel to Cute Fames Adventure. Both games were worked on by a solo developer

• Singleplayer/Story

• Turn-Based Combat

• Full 3D Overhaul

• New Characters
